name: webdesiz
description: Read stored Meta ad account, campaign and daily insight snapshots from your Webdesiz organization. Read-only.
long_description: Ask Claude about the Meta (Facebook + Instagram) advertising data already stored in your Webdesiz organization: ad accounts, campaigns and daily insights. The connection is read-only: it cannot change campaigns or budgets, refresh Meta data, generate ads or spend money. Requires a scoped, expiring Webdesiz developer key created by an organization owner or admin in Settings → Developer keys.

tools.name: webdesiz_insights
tools.description: Stored daily account and campaign insight rows (scope insights:read).

api_key.title: Webdesiz developer key
api_key.description: Create a scoped key at https://webdesiz.com/ayarlar/gelistirici (starts with wd_live_).
